description: Live calendars: works on the real calendars people connected to the app. Lists events between two times, for one account (accountId) or for every account of a person (subjectId). Recurring events are expanded, and events are sorted by start time. To search the title, location and attendees, use query.

accountId.description: A Pyas account ID (list_accounts returns them).

from.description: An ISO 8601 date and time, e.g. 2026-10-21T15:00:00Z (or with an offset).

query.description: Words to find in the title, location or attendees.

subjectId.description: Every account of this person, instead of one accountId.

to.description: An ISO 8601 date and time, e.g. 2026-10-21T15:00:00Z (or with an offset).

name: list_events
title: List events
